2607.28268.title: LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search for Constraint Model Reformulation to Improve Solver Efficiency
2607.28268.paper_summary: Combinatorial problems appear in numerous industrial applications. A common approach is to formulate these problems as declarative constraint models that can subsequently be compiled to and solved by a range of back-end solvers. Recent work shows that Large Language Models (LLMs) can produce correct models from natural language, but even a correct model can be expensive to solve because performance remains sensitive to modelling choices. In this work, we investigate whether LLMs can automate performance-oriented model reformulation. Inspired by Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD), we use an evolutionary framework in which an LLM proposes candidate reformulations that are verified and benchmarked against the user-defined baseline model. We compare AHD-adapted search strategies that control which prior attempts, instructions, and measured feedback enter each prompt. Existing retention strategies prioritize recency or performance, but do not explicitly diversify the context. To cover this gap, we introduce Profile-Diverse Retention (PDR), which applies Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) to instance-level runtime vectors to retain behaviourally diverse attempts. We systematically evaluate the strategies on eight CSPLib problems using validation-based final model selection. The results show that: (i) iterative reformulation can produce substantial held-out speedups; (ii) strategies that keep the retained context diverse outperform those that retain only recent or the fastest attempts; and (iii) validation-based selection improves the held-out speedup of every strategy.
2607.28268.paper_summary_zh: 組合問題出現在許多工業應用中。<lb/>一種常見的方法是將這些問題表述為可聲明的約束模型，然後可以將其編譯並由一系列後端求解器解決。<lb/>最近的研究顯示，大型語言模型（LLMs）可以從自然語言生成正確的模型，但即使是正確的模型，由於性能對建模選擇仍然敏感，解決起來也可能代價高昂。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們研究LLMs是否可以自動化以性能為導向的模型重構。<lb/>受到自動啟發式設計（AHD）的啟發，我們使用一個進化框架，其中LLM提出候選重構，並對其進行驗證和基準測試，與用戶定義的基準模型進行比較。<lb/>我們比較了適應AHD的搜索策略，這些策略控制哪些先前的嘗試、指令和測量的反饋進入每個提示中。<lb/>現有的保留策略優先考慮近期性或性能，但並未明確多樣化上下文。<lb/>為了填補這一空白，我們引入了配置多樣化保留（PDR），該方法將最大邊際相關性（MMR）應用於實例級運行時向量，以保留行為上多樣化的嘗試。<lb/>我們在八個CSPLib問題上系統地評估這些策略，使用基於驗證的最終模型選擇。<lb/>結果顯示：（i）迭代重構可以產生顯著的保留加速；（ii）保持保留上下文多樣化的策略優於僅保留最近或最快嘗試的策略；（iii）基於驗證的選擇改善了每個策略的保留加速。
